record_type_quote: Curioni et al. (2022; https://doi.org/10.1098/rspb.2022.0128) recently found in a series of experiments that humans demonstrated a consistent preference to perform a box-clearing task with a partner, rather than alone, despite this way of completing the task being more costly. Here we will assess the replicability of this effect in an experiment modeled after Experiment 1 in their paper.
